title: Deductible Basis for Refunds: The Deductible Taken From the Claim Payments
content:
**Rule.** Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), the deductible a refund is figured on is the deductible taken from the claim's own payments:
- **Repair payments carry a deductible.** When repair payments on the claim carry a deductible, it is the total of the deductibles those repair payments carry.
- **Only total loss payments carry one.** When no repair payment on the claim carries a deductible and total loss payments on it do, it is the total of the deductibles those total loss payments carry.
- **No payment carries one.** When no payment on the claim carries a deductible, it is the package's collision deductible.

| Deductible recorded on the claim's payment ledger | Deductible a refund is figured on |
|---|---|
| On one or more repair payments | The total of the deductibles on the repair payments |
| None on repair payments, some on total loss payments | The total of the deductibles on the total loss payments |
| None on any payment | The package's collision deductible |

The package collision deductibles are:
- 2500 USD on the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,500 Deductible package;
- 2000 USD on the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible package;
- 1500 USD on the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,500 Deductible package;
- 1000 USD on the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible package;
- 500 USD on both the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $500 Deductible and the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $250 Comprehensive / $500 Collision Deductible packages.

### Hypothetical cases

- A claim whose one repair payment withheld 750.00 USD is figured on 750.00 USD.
- A claim paid only by a total loss payment that withheld 1,250.00 USD is figured on 1,250.00 USD.
- A Florida windshield claim paid with no deductible withheld, on the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible package, is figured on 1000 USD.
